The shotgun_scalper Stage-3 parameter sweep identified a top-performing combo that improves wide P&L and Sharpe via adjusted exit parameters (TP/SL/time stop) and contract selection. However, the edge capture on J's anchor days remains below the OP-16 floor, indicating the improvement may not generalize to the strategy's core edge source.

## Mechanism

Entry logic remains unchanged from baseline shotgun_scalper (directional participation scoring). Exit parameters modified: take profit at +150% premium (tp_premium_pct=1.5), stop loss at -35% premium (stop_premium_pct=-0.35), time stop at 15 minutes. Contract selection uses strike_offset=2 (ITM-2). Volatility filter requires vol_ratio_threshold>=1.0. Chandelier profit-lock arms at 50% profit (chandelier_arm_pct=0.5).
